name: outputs.Setups.FreyaPageOptimizedTime.Params.mk.noConfusion
type_text:
{P : Sort u} →
  {d m n : ℕ} →
    {Lminus Lpm Δ ε : ℝ} →
      {x0 : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d} →
        {τ : Fin n → ENNReal} →
          {Lplus lower : ℝ} →
            {d' m' n' : ℕ} →
              {Lminus' Lpm' Δ' ε' : ℝ} →
                {x0' : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d'} →
                  {τ' : Fin n' → ENNReal} →
                    {Lplus' lower' : ℝ} →
                      { d := d, m := m, n := n, Lminus := Lminus, Lpm := Lpm, Δ := Δ, ε := ε, x0 := x0, τ := τ,
                            Lplus := Lplus, lower := lower } =
                          { d := d', m := m', n := n', Lminus := Lminus', Lpm := Lpm', Δ := Δ', ε := ε', x0 := x0',
                            τ := τ', Lplus := Lplus', lower := lower' } →
                        (d = d' →
                            m = m' →
                              n = n' →
                                Lminus = Lminus' →
                                  Lpm = Lpm' →
                                    Δ = Δ' → ε = ε' → x0 ≍ x0' → τ ≍ τ' → Lplus = Lplus' → lower = lower' → P) →
                          P
